Aster is a tier-1 customer with a P1 / P2 response commitment; I want to lock a temporary contingency that keeps their P1 window covered without a full SLA amendment.

- Secondary: Alex Martinez — reachable by pager and Slack, will take escalations beyond 30 min
- Tertiary (emergency): Jonas Weber — will act as hot backup for any infrastructure-wide incidents

Operational notes and mitigations are attached ("aster-sla-temp-delegation-plan.xlsx") including required keyboard/reporting handoff, runbook links, and contact matrix. We will not change contractual terms — this is an operational carve-in and must be timeboxed.

Requesting: Marissa — authorization for the temporary escalation ladder change and approval to notify Aster. Alex/Soojin/Jonas — acknowledgement and confirmation you can cover the windows.

Thanks,
Tessa
